title: FakeWatch ElectionShield!: A Benchmarking Framework to Detect Fake News for Credible US Elections
measurement_description: The paper's Named Entity Recognition (NER) analysis measured the frequency with which different entities, including religious communities, were targeted in fake news narratives to influence public opinion.
findings: The paper's Named Entity Recognition (NER) analysis found that fake news strategically focuses on nationalities, political groups, or religious communities to influence opinion.
